scope: Additive high-conviction external research leads supplementing, not replacing, the canonical 48-problem opportunity inventory in opportunities.json.
evidence_limitations: No independent ALPHA reproducibility, accepted buyer orders, collected revenue, actual full-cost margin or historical impossibility is established. Vendor performance is not an executable commercial acceptance test.
decision: Prioritize bounded PROOFWORK and TRUST reproductions; compare PATCH and ENGINEER under permissioned, testable obligations; BIOFORGE is partner dependent. Each lead requires independently verifiable paid outcomes before IGNITE.

recent_crossings.title: PROOFWORK Ω — proof-carrying critical software
recent_crossings.buyer: Secure infrastructure, fintech and software maintainers
recent_crossings.blocked_economic_problem: Critical existing software is costly to prove correct after each release
recent_crossings.newly_reported_technical_change: Google DeepMind reports machine-checked proof artifacts for Signal code; Anthropic reports rapid large-agent theorem formalization
recent_crossings.first_independently_acceptable_paid_outc: Customer-approved, source-bound Lean specification and independently checkable proof for a narrow auth/security property
recent_crossings.strongest_competent_alternative: Experienced formal-methods team, mature static analyzers and conventional audits
recent_crossings.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: Select one small publicly available auth library with permission; freeze 3 security invariants; compare manually approved spec+AI prover with expert assisted methods; inject a violating mutant
recent_crossings.potential_compounding_asset: Reusable verified specification library, cross-version proof infrastructure and trust distribution
live_bottlenecks: DeepMind released artifacts, not turnkey general proof automation
Model cost and proof coverage unknown

recent_crossings.title: PATCH Ω — continuous independently verified vulnerability remediation
recent_crossings.buyer: Authorized code owners and open-source maintainers
recent_crossings.blocked_economic_problem: Security defects accumulate faster than maintainers can assess and remediate them
recent_crossings.newly_reported_technical_change: OpenAI disclosed controlled-environment security pipeline reproducing 1,724 findings and deriving 948 unique LPE-associated patch cases at $1.2m in API credits
recent_crossings.first_independently_acceptable_paid_outc: Consent-based remediation package: root-cause account, candidate fix, isolated regression test and independent maintainer acceptance
recent_crossings.strongest_competent_alternative: Specialized security engineering teams, SAST vendors, established disclosure and patching programs
recent_crossings.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: On an owner-authorized toy codebase with seeded defects, test minimal proof-of-fix and regression suite versus a capable conventional scanner+engineer workflow; no operational exploitation
recent_crossings.potential_compounding_asset: Permitted codebase-specific regression corpora, verification harnesses, responsible disclosure relationships
live_bottlenecks: OpenAI evaluation relied on an upcoming restricted-capability model
Human review and responsible disclosure mandatory
Never equate bug bounty theoretical valuation with revenue

recent_crossings.title: TRUST Ω — verifiable inference receipt gateway
recent_crossings.buyer: AI inference providers, high-assurance enterprise customers and independent auditors
recent_crossings.blocked_economic_problem: Model substitution and computation integrity cannot be checked from ordinary model responses
recent_crossings.newly_reported_technical_change: Anthropic released runnable FlashProve cryptographic inference proofs for specified quantized MoE configuration, about 110 proven tokens/s on H100 and about 19 MB per 1024 tokens
recent_crossings.first_independently_acceptable_paid_outc: Independently checked receipt for an agreed supported quantized inference configuration
recent_crossings.strongest_competent_alternative: Trusted hardware attestation, signed logs, vendor reputation and existing proof systems
recent_crossings.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: Run stock released prover and verifier on one approved configuration; measure wall clock, proof size, GPU time, verifier integrity and acceptable buyer use case
recent_crossings.potential_compounding_asset: Verifier API standard, proof receipt interoperability, provenance distribution
live_bottlenecks: Reported proof overhead is 70–95x baseline GPU time
Proof does not attest to external business-process correctness

recent_crossings.title: ENGINEER Ω — verified digital-to-physical engineering foundry
recent_crossings.buyer: Electronic component suppliers, small OEMs and industrial product teams
recent_crossings.blocked_economic_problem: Custom small hardware is slowed by multidisciplinary engineering, prototyping and manufacturing handoffs
recent_crossings.newly_reported_technical_change: OpenAI showcased AI CAD/PCB/firmware workflow Nov 3; Anthropic reports Fable 5.2 helped design three working electronic devices Nov 9
recent_crossings.first_independently_acceptable_paid_outc: Editable CAD, PCB and firmware files plus simulator results and contract-manufacturer acceptance checks for one narrow device class
recent_crossings.strongest_competent_alternative: Specialist electrical/mechanical engineering firms and EDA automation
recent_crossings.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: Reproduce a defined non-safety-critical device with DRC/ERC, BOM availability and partner prototyping; compare expert engineer and AI assisted results under identical requirements
recent_crossings.potential_compounding_asset: Reusable domain design rules, validated parts libraries, manufacturing acceptance patterns
live_bottlenecks: Physical validation and product liability remain
Materials and contract manufacturing cannot be performed by software alone

recent_crossings.title: BIOFORGE Ω — partner-lab validated biological invention
recent_crossings.buyer: Industrial biotech and responsible materials-development firms
recent_crossings.blocked_economic_problem: Promising biomolecular designs require expensive multidisciplinary optimization and wet-lab confirmation
recent_crossings.newly_reported_technical_change: UW/NVIDIA released RFD4-Proteina Oct 21; Nature reported AutoDNA instrument orchestration across >11,000 steps Nov 4
recent_crossings.first_independently_acceptable_paid_outc: Lawful, independently tested industrial-biomolecular candidate with measured function and agreed licensing rights
recent_crossings.strongest_competent_alternative: Experienced protein-design lab, contract research organizations and conventional design software
recent_crossings.cheapest_discriminating_experiment: For a safe nonclinical industrial protein target, obtain qualified partner agreement, freeze acceptance protocol, compare candidate design/validation cost and yield with incumbent method
recent_crossings.potential_compounding_asset: Cumulative valid experimental outcomes, defensible licenses and repeatable lab integration
live_bottlenecks: Actual IP rights and reproducibility unknown

future_watchlist.name: ROBOT Ω
future_watchlist.reason: Partner-only model access and nontrivial hardware operation; track independent per-task unit economics and true reliability.

future_watchlist.name: GENOME Ω
future_watchlist.reason: Noncommercial API generally available; commercial preview restricted. Wait for licensing, clinical validity boundaries and independent buyer tests.

future_watchlist.name: SIMULATE Ω
future_watchlist.reason: Waitlist accessibility and simulation-to-physical transfer validation block paid physical-control claims.

future_watchlist.name: OPERATE Ω
future_watchlist.reason: Low-cost computer use is available; require a measurable newly profitable complete buyer workflow versus competent automation alternatives.
